# OmniExecutor Agent

> Autonomous software engineering harness with a durable SQLite-WAL execution engine, executable verification oracle (`--verify`), pipe-aware fail-closed command gating, hierarchical multi-wave team orchestrator (`solo_specialist` -> `dev_squad` -> `executive_enterprise_fleet`), self-healing CDP browser engine, closed-loop Windows desktop RPA, AST-sealed adaptive Python skills, and native MCP / A2A v0.3 / AG-UI protocol support.

## Canonical Documentation
- [README.md](README.md): Complete user & developer guide covering installation, 29 CLI subcommands, 34 workspace tools, 220 deterministic zero-token rails, 10 engineering personas, MCP/ACP/A2A/AG-UI integrations, 15 SAST rules, playbooks, benchmarks, and caveats.
- [docs/ENGINEERING_AND_MATH_MANUAL.md](docs/ENGINEERING_AND_MATH_MANUAL.md): Exact mathematical formulations (durable effect fencing, Brier autonomy tiers, PageRank code centrality, RAM worker scaling, Casimir storage pressure, UCB1 evolution, pipe-aware command classification, and two-stage tool probability selection).
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Setup, automated verification gate, constitutional seal boundaries, and extension points.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): Defense-in-depth security architecture, secret/SAST rules, symlink protection, and reporting policy.
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT License.

## Entry Points
- Public Python Facade: `from am_ua import OmniExecutorAgent` (`src/am_ua/__init__.py` -> `src/am_ua/agent_kernel.py`)
- Installed Console CLI (`pyproject.toml` `[project.scripts]`): `omni-executor` / `omni` (`src/am_ua/cli.py`)
- Windows CLI Wrapper: `omni-executor.cmd` (`src/am_ua/cli.py`)
- MCP Server (`stdio`, JSON-RPC 2.0): `omni-executor.cmd mcp-serve` (`src/am_ua/execution/mcp_federation.py`)
- ACP Server (`stdio`, JSON-RPC 2.0): `omni-executor.cmd acp-serve` (`src/am_ua/execution/acp_adapter.py`)
- A2A v0.3 & Channel Gateway: `SubAgentSessionBus.handle_a2a_rpc` / `ingest_channel_event` (`src/am_ua/execution/subagent_bus.py`)
- Live AG-UI SSE Stream: `--agui-port <port>` (`src/am_ua/cognition/agui_protocol.py`)

## CLI Subcommands (29)
- `vault add|list|revoke`: Host-only DPAPI/PBKDF2 encrypted `BlindSecretVault` with strict domain pinning (`fill_secret` never exposes plaintext to LLMs) (v14.0).
- `schedule add|list|pause|resume|tick`: Natural-language recurring scheduler (`NaturalScheduleParser`), monthly USD estimation, and wake-after-sleep catch-up (v14.0).
- `memory list|delete|firewall-stats`: Transparent Triad Memory & procedural note CRUD + `MemoryProvenanceFirewall` stats (v14.0).
- `receipt list`: Signed `TaskAuditReceipt` ledger with vault aliases used, external approvals/blocks, TTFT, and USD cost (v14.0).
- `workflow draft|test|publish|list|troubleshoot`: `Draft -> Sample-Test -> Publish Gate` automation lifecycle (n8n MCP compatible) (v14.0).
- `pr audit|create|check [--dry-run] [--pr N]`: Governed GitHub Pull Request bridge (`GitHubPRBridge`) with `AgentShield` pre-flight gate and CI check inspection (v13.0).
- `route --query "<objective>" [--stage locate|reason|verify]`: Complexity scoring (`0.0–1.0`), token budget sizing, and SkillOrchestra per-stage provider recommendation (v12.0+).
- `evolve-ace [--status]`: Inspect native zero-dep ACE Context Playbook (`[str-XXXXX] helpful=N harmful=M`) and SpecSearch self-evolution status (v12.0).
- `ui [--port 8765]`: Localhost Web Mission Control dashboard streaming AG-UI SSE events with live on-demand vs fixed USD budget toggle.
- `chat [--yolo]`: Interactive streaming TUI console with `[y/n/a/e]` diff approval and slash commands (`/cost`, `/budget`, `/playbook`, `/rails`, `/shield`).
- `det list|run|list-playbooks|run-playbook`: Programmable 220-rail zero-token matrix and 18 pre-fixed parametric playbooks (`Code`/`Windows`/`Browser`/`Docker`) with safe variable binding.
- `swebench validate-predictions|run`: On-demand SWE-bench dataset loader, Docker Linux runtime routing (`python:2.7-slim`/`3.9-slim`/`3.11-slim`), Terminal-Bench/WebArena adapters, & predictions validator.
- `fleet`: Run v5.4+ HyperFleet high-density concurrent multi-agent coordinator.
- `lsp diagnostics|definition|references|hover`: Real JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio `PersistentLSPClient` (`basedpyright-langserver`/`pyright-langserver`) with deterministic typecheck & AST fallback.
- `daemon enqueue|stats|claim|drain`: Always-on SQLite WAL background task queue & `DurableDaemonWorker` (crash-lease recovery + Record-and-Replay).
- `doctor`: Multi-organ readiness, SQLite-WAL single state owner, SHA-256 constitutional seal, and host headroom.
- `shield [target]`: Static security & SAST scanner (`Grade A`–`F` across 15 rules).
- `mission "<objective>"`: Autonomous coding/browser/desktop execution verified against `--verify` (`--workflow react|sparc|hierarchical`, `--role`, `--best-of-n`, `--wheel-timeout`, `--agui-port`).
- `repomap [target]`: Polyglot AST symbol map ranked with PageRank (`Python`, `JS/TS`, `Rust`, `Go`).
- `radar [target]`: Topological coupling & cohesion summary.
- `browser observe|act|extract`: Isolated Playwright/CDP browser with `[1..N]` indexed DOM, self-healing selectors, and payment hard-stop guard.
- `pc probe|windows|observe|find|clipboard|processes|port`: Closed-loop Windows UIA + Set-of-Mark + OCR automation.
- `skills list|search|run`: AST-gated, SHA-256 sealed adaptive Python skills & CLI wrappers.
- `mcp-serve`: Expose 7 tools over MCP `stdio`.
- `acp-serve`: Expose interactive agent sessions over ACP `stdio` (`initialize`, `session/new`, `session/prompt`, `session/cancel`).
- `bench run|report`: Execute or summarize sealed evaluation tasks (`eval/am_bench/`).
- `wheel status|resume|abort`: Human-in-the-loop pause/resume control.
- `ingest-doc <file>`: Ingest `.docx`/`.xlsx`/`.csv`/`.pdf`/`.md` with external taint tracking.
- `handoff`: Export portable `HANDOFF_PACK`.
- `pipeline "<objective>"`: Deterministic diagnostic pipeline.

## Key Subsystems (`src/am_ua/`)
- `governance/seal_guard.py`: SHA-256 manifest enforcement over protected zones (`constitution/`, `eval/`).
- `governance/homeostasis.py`: RAM, disk pressure (`F_c(d)`), token budget, and stagnation governor.
- `execution/durable_engine.py`: SQLite-WAL durable state owner, effect taxonomy, `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` recovery, lease-epoch fencing, and time-travel `fork_run_from_step()`.
- `execution/hook_engine.py`: Deterministic `PreToolUse`/`PostToolUse` hooks, `ToolOutputGuardrail` + `ToolGuardrailTripwireError` + `post_output_secret_redactor`, secret write blocker, `pre_write_test_tamper_guard`, Python AST checker, pipe-aware 5-class command classifier (`READ | WRITE | NETWORK | INSTALL | DESTRUCTIVE`), structural `PolicyRails` (`fetch-to-exec`, `raw-disk-op`, `catastrophic-delete`), opaque subshell escalation (`UNKNOWN`), and worst-case `evaluate_ensemble_risk`.
- `cognition/llm_client.py`: Multi-provider client (`OpenAI`, `Anthropic`, `Gemini Native`, `Groq`, `OpenRouter`, `Ollama`) with native `tools`/`tool_calls`, explicit `cache_control` prompt caching, `reasoning_effort` thinking budgets, and SSE tool-call streaming.
- `execution/agent_loop.py` + `execution/workspace_tools.py` + `execution/tool_schemas.py`: Native tool-calling ReAct/SPARC/Hierarchical loop, parallel `ThreadPoolExecutor` dispatch for `PURE_READ` batches, dynamic first-class MCP tool mounting (`mcp__<server>__<tool>`), atomic `_condense` over `tool_calls` pairs, Turn-0 workspace inventory, multi-hunk transactional `replace_in_file`, `task_tracker`, `spill_query`, `code_sandbox`, SSRF-guarded `web_fetch`, typed `output_schema`, runtime `handoff_agent`, symlink escape guard, and `ROLE_TOOL_SCOPES`.
- `cognition/reasoning_bank.py`: Hybrid Jaccard + SONA trajectory replay with `sleeptime_consolidate()` and `consult_tom()` background user-model synthesis.
- `execution/subagent_bus.py`: 3-tier severity-scored team orchestration (`1 -> 4 -> 9` agents across 4 waves, max depth `2`, max `16` agents, exclusive GUI lock), `ROLE_PROVIDER_PROFILES`, dependency-aware `execute_dag()`, A2A v0.3 JSON-RPC, and inbound channel burst debouncing.
- `gui/cdp_browser.py`: Indexed CDP browser with `allowed_domains`/`prohibited_domains`/`block_ip_addresses` domain guard, self-healing DOM recovery, and checkout/payment boundary hard stop.
- `memory/triad_provider.py` + `memory/msea_native.py` + `memory/hybrid_vector_index.py`: 100% portable pure-Python Triad Memory (RAM core blocks + bi-temporal SQLite + native Q-utility/R13 MSEA engine + SQLite FTS5 BM25 & cosine RRF hybrid search) wired live into `AgentLoop` prefetch & outcome reinforcement with `ScopedMemoryFacade` namespace isolation.
- `execution/worktree_swarm.py` + `execution/subagent_bus.py`: Parallel `git worktree` swarm (`GitWorktreeManager` + `WorktreeSwarmCoordinator`) spawning concurrent `AgentLoop` workers with 3-way merge & conflict resolution (`fleet --worktrees`), plus 1,000-agent `HyperFleet`, A2A v0.3 JSON-RPC, and channel gateway.
- `perception/`: `code_property_graph.py` (AST/CFG/Dataflow CPG & SCIP index `cpg_impact`), `efficiency_telemetry.py` (`TTFT`, `ITL p50/p95`, `GFLOPs`), `polyglot_repomap.py` (PageRank), `knowledge_index.py` (SHA-256 incremental tree index & Mermaid export), `silicon_radar.py`.
- `cognition/stage_router.py`: `ComplexityQueryAnalyzer`, `StageSkillHandbook` (SkillOrchestra per-stage routing `locate`/`reason`/`verify`), and `LearnedRouterPolicy` (`min_samples` trace-driven routing).
- `evolution/spec_search_ace.py`: `SpecSearchOrchestrator` (`Diagnose -> RiskTier -> Checkpoint -> BenchmarkRegressionGate -> Rollback`) and native zero-dep `ACEContextPlaybook`.
- `execution/record_replay.py` + `execution/playbook_compiler.py` + `execution/wasm_sandbox.py`: Temporal-style deterministic record-and-replay (`NonDeterminismDriftError`), `TurnZeroPlaybookRouter`, `TraceToPlaybookCompiler`, and zero-Docker `WasmSandboxRunner`.
- `security/agent_shield.py` + `security/runtime_taint.py`: 15-rule static SAST scanner, `prove_policy_containment()`, runtime `RuntimeTaintTracker` (`PII`/`SECRET`/`EXTERNAL` + `SINK_POLICY`), `SSRFValidator`, and `MountAllowlistGuard`.
